verdict.rationale: The only programmatic/agent surface documented is the MCP integration, which is explicitly described as read-only ('Ask your AI assistant about shareholders, option pool headroom, vesting, share classes, SAFEs and notes - answered from your live Cap Table in Cake. All read-only.'), and there is no OpenAPI/API surface (probe shows 404s) or any mention of drafting option grants or queuing items for board approval via an agent.
